items.title: Make agent discovery validate typed diagnostic receipts and explain every honest-dark omission
items.why: build-agents-json.mjs curates build-check and proof-surface diagnostics whenever their paths exist. A truncated, stale-plan, integrity-mutated, partial, or structurally malformed receipt is still advertised as authoritative verification, and agents.json has no channel for explaining why a feed was withheld.
items.premise: Both receipts already have strong validators, but the proof validator is trapped inside an executable orchestrator. Extracting a typed, import-safe contract registry lets discovery validate each feed before advertising it and publish deterministic omission reasons without turning missing evidence into green or red.
liveEvidence: buildFeeds() checks only existsSync(abs) before adding every catalog entry
validateBuildCheckEvidence already rejects count, coverage, plan, source, age-adjacent, and receipt-integrity drift
validateProofDiagnostics exists but importing check-proof-surface.mjs would execute the orchestrator
agents.json currently advertises both diagnostic URLs with no validity or omission contract
the audit success bar requires a concrete information-finding outcome for every item
items.outcome: agent information-finding: an agent sees only structurally valid verification feeds, while discovery.omissions names the exact public-safe reason any expected diagnostic surface is unavailable; malformed evidence can no longer borrow authority from a URL.
items.recipe: Extract proof receipt validation into an import-safe library, add a small typed public-feed contract registry used by build-agents-json, validate complete build coverage and complete proof enforcement coverage, emit stable discovery.omissions entries for expected-but-invalid feeds, add malformed/partial/integrity-mutated fixtures, and verify generated agents.json plus the discovery spine.

L1.recipe: Validate the two diagnostic JSON shapes before inclusion.

L2.recipe: Extract import-safe validators and add invalid fixtures.

L3.recipe: Create a reusable typed feed registry, emit honest-dark omission reasons, cover integrity/coverage drift, and prove discovery output remains deterministic.

executionLog.note: Extracted import-safe proof diagnostics and a typed public-feed contract registry. Agent discovery now advertises a diagnostic URL only when its complete coverage, current build plan, row counts, enforcement classes, and content receipt validate; otherwise discovery points are null and a public-safe omission reason is emitted. Focused contracts 20/20 plus proof 15/15 and discovery-spine green.

items.title: Turn every Hetzner staging deploy into one atomic, content-bound, remotely verifiable attestation
items.why: deploy-staging.mjs prints a file count, archive size, and rollback path to transient stdout, then discards them. staging-health separately proves candidate SHA and critical-byte parity, but release-proof cannot prove which deploy created that state, which source fingerprint was archived, whether the remote file count matched the bounded manifest, or which rollback snapshot corresponds to the candidate.
items.premise: The deployer already owns the safe file manifest, archive, timestamped rollback, remote root, and credential-resolved SSH channel; the parity checker already owns post-deploy candidate truth. One public-safe receipt can bind those facts, validate them after the remote write, and become a first-class release-proof dependency without exposing credentials.
liveEvidence: deploy-staging.mjs emits STAGING_DEPLOYED plus details only to stdout
no api/staging-deploy-receipt.json or durable deploy ledger exists
the script knows manifest.length, archiveBytes, stamp, and bounded remoteRoot
api/staging-health.json separately carries candidate SHA, Merkle root, leaf count, and parity findings
build-release-proof.mjs consumes staging health but no deploy provenance receipt
items.outcome: release information-finding: the founder and release gate can answer exactly what was deployed, from which source and candidate root, how many bounded public files landed, which rollback snapshot owns it, whether post-deploy parity passed, and whether the receipt served by staging matches the local attestation.
items.recipe: Add a pure staging-deploy receipt contract with content ID and atomic JSON writes; make deploy-staging compute the source fingerprint and archive digest, record the safe manifest/file count plus rollback id, run a fresh parity probe after rsync, write the final receipt locally and atomically install it on staging, fetch it back for equality validation, fold it into release-proof and the evidence graph, and cover malformed roots, count mismatch, parity failure, replay, and secret-redaction fixtures.

L1.recipe: Persist the current console values in a public-safe JSON receipt.

L2.recipe: Bind candidate SHA/root/source fingerprint and consume the receipt from release proof.

L3.recipe: Add atomic local/remote installation, archive digest, remote equality verification, replay-resistant identity, parity evidence, evidence-graph reachability, and full negative fixtures.

executionLog.note: Deployer now SHA-256 verifies the transferred archive, measures the bounded remote file count, binds source fingerprint + candidate root + rollback snapshot + parity, atomically installs the receipt on staging twice (pending then verified), fetches exact bytes back, and fails on mismatch. Live receipt ac620c4aade825c3146c1460 attests 4,287 files, rollback 20260728221222, exact SHA/root candidate-green; release proof and the 16-node evidence graph consume it.

items.title: Ship a reproducible Ark dossier for the protocol-currency false green
items.why: The local propagated docs/SESSION_PROTOCOL.md points /audit and /implement at sections that do not exist, while the authoritative studio-ops copy contains §2B and §2C. Startup applied pending propagation and Doctor still reported the propagated document current, so agent-neutral command fidelity can silently degrade while observability says green.
items.premise: The canonical protocol and propagation checker are sibling-owned. A signed Ark dossier with hashes, section probes, and acceptance tests is the only compliant repair path; editing the local propagated copy would create a fork and violate CANON-018.
liveEvidence: local docs/SESSION_PROTOCOL.md has no §2B or §2C headings
the local command table points /audit to §4 and /implement to §5, which are initiate and studio-review sections
apply-pending-propagation made no repair and Doctor reported propagated-doc current
items.outcome: agent orientation: every agent receives the real audit/implement protocol, and the currency probe fails when semantic section coverage differs even if a coarse version marker or tracked-file hash appears current.
items.recipe: Ship a signed repo-question to studio-ops with local/canonical section inventories and exact acceptance tests: propagated copies include every canonical command heading, command-table targets resolve, apply-pending repairs the copy, and Doctor cannot report propagated-doc green on semantic drift. Request a receipt; do not edit the sibling or local canonical copy manually.

L2.recipe: Include hashes, command-table target mismatch, and executable acceptance tests.

L3.recipe: Add semantic propagation-coverage design, backward compatibility expectations, and a signed repair receipt request.
